name: Twisted Hatred
summary: Tallonkai Swiftroot sends trusted champions into Fel Rock to stop Lord Melenas. The satyr has rallied the cave’s grell into an organized force, threatening night elf settlements near Teldrassil.

sections.title: A Bitter Disgrace
sections.body: Satyrs recall an ancient betrayal that still stains kaldorei history. They were Highborne who gave themselves to the Burning Legion during the War of the Ancients. Now one has made a foothold on Teldrassil, the young World Tree meant to be a sanctuary. For defenders like Tallonkai Swiftroot, that presence is a bitter disgrace.

sections.title: The Threat at Fel Rock
sections.body: Fel Rock lies north of the nearby paths, its corrupted caverns crawling with feral grell. Lord Melenas has gathered the chaotic creatures into a hostile force under his will. Tallonkai fears what the satyr may unleash on the World Tree’s boughs, and demands a swift, quiet end. He wants Melenas eliminated and his severed head brought back.

faq.answer: Lord Melenas is a satyr who has claimed Fel Rock in northern Teldrassil. He commands aggressive grell warriors and schemes to spread corruption through the World Tree.

faq.q: Where can I find Lord Melenas?
faq.answer: Lord Melenas lurks deep within Fel Rock, north of Dolanaar in Teldrassil. Grell and other corrupted creatures surround him.

faq.q: Why does Tallonkai Swiftroot want this kept secret?
aliases: why must this stay between us
faq.answer: Satyrs recall the night elves’ ancient betrayal during the War of the Ancients. A satyr’s bold presence within the young World Tree is a disgrace, and Tallonkai wants to resolve it without widespread panic.

faq.q: What is the relationship between satyrs and grell?
faq.answer: Grell are small, mischievous, naturally corrupted wild creatures found across Teldrassil. Satyrs can bully or bend these lesser creatures to serve their ambitions.

faq.q: Why are there satyrs on Teldrassil in the first place?
faq.answer: Teldrassil was grown only a few years ago, and corruption and dark beings quickly reached the island despite the druids’ hopes for a clean sanctuary. Satyrs slipped in and made footholds in shadowy places like Fel Rock.
Tallonkai Swiftroot is a night elf guardian stationed near Dolanaar. He watches for threats to Teldrassil and sends adventurers to deal with nearby pockets of corruption.

angles.text: As a night elf, you face an ancient reminder of your ancestors’ fall to demonic ambition. Defeating Lord Melenas is a duty to the World Tree and an act of ancestral penance.
As a druid, you find Melenas and his corrupted grell poisoning the fragile balance of Teldrassil’s young wilderness.
